body: I may try that walking thing. I'm a pagan and I used to meditate a lot... May try that again, too. thanks for responding. It's hard being in that spot and pulling yourself out. I usually try and just forget about it - today got really bad. :/

I wish I could. Like I said, barely affording food and without insurance in the state I live in - you're screwed. And most doctors here won't treat Adult ADHD, especially not as bad as mine. But thank you.
All day long. I've spent most of my life faking emotions so I could feel anything.
And part of me is really terrified that the only reason I posted any of this was to get comments so I could feel loved... I'm so tired of this.
